comparison.objective: Safely disconnect a pneumatic tube and blank the open manifold port.
comparison.physical_skill: Close a valve, depress a collet while extracting a tube, then align and insert a plug.
comparison.success_condition: Valve closed, line released, plug seated and released; releasing while pressurized permanently fails. No impact-performance rubric.
comparison.reason: Tests energy isolation followed by compliant release and insertion, not adjustment of an installed damper or repeated stopping behavior.
